input.brief: Nguyen Hoang Long, backend and automation engineer, a personal portfolio inside the existing foldable device. Follow the supplied visual references: white portrait-led lockscreen, large condensed name, split introduction and portrait, three slim OS notifications, quiet monochrome work archive.

direction.name: The name as a monument
direction.idea: The name is the headline. Set it so large that it becomes architecture: as wide as the viewport, cropped by an edge, or stacked to fill the screen. Nothing else on the first screen competes; the description of what this is drops to a single small sentence. The idea comes from treating the name's letters as material. Ask what the subject can do to its own name: a photograph of the work sits inside a counter or replaces a letter, the name repeats down the page like a reel, the letters are split to opposite corners and the page happens between them. In the study this was the single most common device among sites scoring 7.5 or more.
direction.composition: First screen: the wordmark spans 88–100% of the viewport width (font-size 16–24vw, set with a clamp so it never wraps), anchored either to the bottom edge with its descenders nearly touching it, or dead centre with everything else pushed to the corners. One line of supporting text at 16–20px sits in a corner on a shared margin; navigation is three or four words in the opposite corner. After the hero the page is deliberately small and calm: a narrow text column or a simple two-column grid, so the contrast with the monument holds. The name returns once more at full width as the footer, in the inverse colours. Margins are tight (20–32px) so the type reaches the edges. Two type sizes do nearly all the work: the monument and a small text size, with one mid size for section headings.
direction.typography: One family. The display cut must survive enormous sizes: tight tracking (-0.04 to -0.07em), leading 0.8–0.9, optical kerning on. Section headings are modest (28–40px) on purpose.
direction.colour: Two values carry the page (ground and ink). The accent, if used at all, appears on one thing only: the single action or the inset image frame. The footer inverts ground and ink.
direction.imagery: Few images, used as inserts in the typography rather than as illustrations beside it: one photograph inside or behind the name (a 4:5 or 1:1 frame replacing a letter, or tucked between two words), then a short run of large full-width or half-width photographs further down. Square corners. No collage of small thumbnails.
direction.richness: Scale. The size of the name against the smallness of everything else is the entire visual event, so protect both ends: do not shrink the name to make room, and do not let body text creep above 20px.
direction.pitfalls: A long name set small is just a logo. If the name has more than about 12 characters, stack it on two lines or crop it with the viewport edge; never drop below 12vw. Do not add a second big headline under the name. Do not decorate the letters.

hero.name: Stacked name, two inks
hero.blueprint: One saturated flat field covers the whole 1440×900 viewport and there is no image. The name is broken into two lines and set flush left from a 40px margin at clamp(110px, 15vw, 230px), heavy weight, tracking -0.04em, line-height 0.82 so the lines almost touch. The block starts 14% down and fills the top 58% of the screen; the longer line reaches at least column 11. Line one is set in the light ink and line two in the dark ink, so the break reads as a change of voice: split a two-word name between the lines, or break one long name with a hyphen at a syllable. The top edge carries only small text at 15px, 24px in: a monogram top-left, and two or three text links plus the single action as an underlined link top-right. The supporting sentence, 18px in the light ink and max 30ch, is right-aligned in the bottom-right corner on columns 9–12, its last line 40px above the bottom edge. The bottom-left corner stays empty. The next section begins as a different flat field exactly at the fold.
hero.mobile: The field fills 100svh. The name keeps its two lines and two inks at 21vw, flush left at a 16px margin, starting 18% down; a long name hyphenates rather than dropping below 18vw. The supporting sentence moves to the bottom-left at 16px across the full width, with the action as an underlined link beneath it, 24px above the bottom edge. The top-right links reduce to one word.
hero.headline: The name on exactly two lines, one per ink, each line up to about 8 characters at 15vw on desktop and 21vw on a phone.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Portrait as drop cap
sections.blueprint: No heading. One biography paragraph of 50–80 words is set large at clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 38px), regular weight, leading 1.2, across columns 3–12 of the grid. A square portrait is floated at the paragraph's start with `float: left`: its side equals three lines of text (3.6em), with 0.5em of space to its right, so the first three lines wrap beside it and the fourth returns to the paragraph's left edge, like a drop capital. Square corners. The person's name, the first words of the paragraph, is in full ink; the rest may be in a softer ink with linked names in full ink and underlined. A second paragraph follows after one blank line in the soft ink at the same size. Columns 1–2 hold three short facts (place, since when, how to reach) at 14px, top-aligned with the portrait. Section padding 140px.
sections.mobile: Text at 22px with leading 1.25, full width. The portrait keeps its float but grows to four lines tall, about 110px square. The three facts move below the second paragraph as a single row of three small blocks at 13px.

sections.name: Big names, fixed preview
sections.blueprint: Project names are the index. In columns 1–8, five to nine names stack one per line at clamp(44px, 5.4vw, 80px), leading 1.0, each row a link with 10px of vertical padding. All names rest in the ink at 35% opacity except the active one, which is full ink; the first is active by default, and hover or keyboard focus moves the state. To the right of each name, on its baseline at 14px: the discipline and the year. In columns 9–12 a `position: sticky; top: 15vh` frame, 4:5 and 26vw wide with square corners, shows the active project's photograph; all images are stacked in the frame and swapped by opacity over 200ms. A two-word heading at 28px sits top-left, 48px above the first name. Nothing is drawn between rows: the size of the type and the dimming do the separating.
sections.mobile: Names at 9.5vw, all in full ink, one per line; discipline and year sit beneath each name at 13px. There is no sticky frame: each name is preceded by its own photograph at 16:10, full width, so the list becomes image then name, repeated, with 40px between projects.

sections.name: Recognition as a table
sections.blueprint: Awards, press mentions or credits set as a four-column table with no lines. The heading is two or three words at about 5vw, stepped over two lines with the second line indented by two columns, and occupies columns 1–7. The table begins 72px below and spans columns 1–12 on a fixed grid: year in columns 1–2, project or title in 3–6, awarding body or publication in 7–10, the award itself in 11–12, right-aligned. Rows are set at 16–17px with 14px of padding above and below; every second row carries a background tone one step from the ground, running the full table width, which replaces rules. Year groups are separated by one blank row, and the year is printed only on the first row of its group. Use a real `<table>` with `border-collapse: collapse` and no borders.
sections.mobile: The heading drops to 11vw. Each table row becomes a two-line block: title on the first line in the full ink, then body and award on the second in the softer ink. The year stands once as a 22px figure above its group. Alternate blocks keep the background tone.

sections.name: Quiet figure lines
sections.blueprint: Numbers stated without raising the voice. In columns 2–7, a definition-list layout: three to five rows, each a two-track grid. The first track is 132px wide and holds the figure, right-aligned, at 28–32px in medium weight and full ink with tabular numerals. The second track, after a 24px gap, holds one sentence at 16–17px in the soft ink, at most 40ch, whose first baseline matches the figure's baseline. Sentences share one left edge and figures one right edge, so a clean channel of space runs down between them. 28px between rows. The heading, two to four words at 24–28px, sits 56px above on the sentences' left edge, not the figures'. Optionally, a single small square photograph occupies columns 9–11, its top 80px lower than the first row, with no caption. Leave at least 18vh of empty ground above and below the block.
sections.mobile: The grid stays two-track, with the figure track narrowed to 88px and figures at 24px; sentences at 16px wrap beside them. If the photograph is used it comes after the rows at 56% width, flush right. The heading is 22px on the sentences' left edge.

sections.name: The email as display type
sections.blueprint: The section is 100svh in the inverse of the page's colours. A single email address is set as one line of display type spanning the content width: the font-size is fitted so the address runs from margin to margin (about 7–9vw for 20 characters; break after the @ onto two lines if it is longer than 26), light or regular weight, tight tracking, sitting on a baseline 12vh above the bottom edge. It is a `mailto:` link; on hover the whole line takes the accent ink. In the top-left corner, a sentence of up to 12 words at 20–22px says what to write about. In the two bottom corners at 14px: phone and city at the left, two or three social links at the right. No heading and no form. For a pinned ending, make the section `position: sticky; bottom: 0` beneath the page so the previous section lifts off it.
sections.mobile: The address breaks after the @ onto two lines at 11.5vw, left-aligned, sitting at 55% of an 86svh screen. The sentence sits at the top-left at 18px. Phone, city and social links stack at the bottom-left at 15px with 12px between them.

references.name: House of Honey
references.idea: A block-heavy wordmark pierced by a hairline script: the bold-against-delicate contrast is repeated at every scale, with giant pink script behind quiet serif statements.
references.hero: Top 42% is a flat blush-pink band; the bottom 58% is a full-bleed photograph of a bright living room, arched window on the centre axis, butting against the band with no margin. A tiny nav row sits at the very top with 8px side margins: block logo glyph and five links left, contact link with a small square arrow box far right. The wordmark fills the width edge to edge: two words in ultra-black extended caps, about 120px cap height, dark aubergine, with a hairline script 'of' 230px tall between them, overshooting above and below. Directly beneath, two two-line serif uppercase taglines at 31px, one flush left, one flush right.
references.type: Wordmark in ultra-black extended caps; statements in noeText serif, uppercase, 31–40px, tight tracking; nav and captions in neueHaasGrotesk around 14px; 'canora' hairline script for the connecting word and for cropped background words at 37vw. Three contrasting voices, each with one job.
references.colour: #edccbe #331917 #0e0e0e #f26fcb #ffffff — Blush pink and dark aubergine-brown alternate as full fields and as each other's text colour. Hot pink appears only in the oversized script and a 2px divider. Photographs bring saturated colour.
references.imagery: Editorial interior photography, saturated and daylight-lit. Hero is a full-bleed landscape crop; projects are portrait crops about 5:6 in a three-column grid with 4px gutters and square corners.
references.layout: Edge-to-edge with 8px outer margins. Typographic sections (small centred label, serif statement, cropped giant script) alternate with a three-column image grid. Blush and brown fields swap each section; hairline link rows close blocks. The footer is a full-width logo glyph.

sections.description: Dark aubergine field under the hero photo, separated by a 2px hot-pink line. A small sans label centred, then a three-line centred serif uppercase statement at about 31px in blush, 45% of the width. Behind it a hot-pink script phrase set near 37vw runs off both sides and is cut by the section's bottom edge, its ascenders rising into the statement. A smaller serif line follows.

Title card before the project grid. Blush field, nearly empty screen. A small label and a one-line serif uppercase heading about 40px sit centred at 55% height. The giant pink script returns, cropped by the bottom edge so only its top half shows and running off both sides.

Three columns edge to edge with 4px gutters and 8px outer margins. Portrait photos about 500×580px, square corners. Under each: an uppercase sans title at 14px and a grey line of GPS coordinates. Two rows, then a full-width hairline row with a text link left and a small square arrow box at the far right.

Brown field. The logo glyph is enlarged to full width and about a third of the screen: blush rectangles and quarter-circle arcs with 4px gaps, forming an abstract monogram. Below: four columns of small links, a hairline, two addresses in the first two columns, another hairline, then copyright left and a small blush button right.

steal: Set a wordmark edge to edge in ultra-heavy extended caps and thread a hairline script connecting word through it that overshoots the cap height both ways.
Use an oversized script word in one hot accent colour as a cropped background layer behind small, calm serif statements.
Split a tagline into two halves, flush left and flush right on the same baseline under the wordmark, instead of centring it.
references.media: The lower 58% of the fold is a full-bleed interior photograph that continues for one full viewport as a five-image crossfading slideshow with a pink progress line on its bottom edge. Below: a three-up grid of 4:5 project tiles with 8px gutters sliding over a giant script marquee, a full-bleed tinted feature photograph with its title docked bottom-left, a full-bleed photograph with an inset colour card, and one giant cropped letterform as the footer's picture, the photographs oversized to 110-170% of their frames for drift and no video anywhere.
references.motion: There is no visible preloader and the page is whole at 400ms; under Lenis, blocks rise 8px and fade in over 800ms ease-out at 0-260ms staggers (39 WAAPI calls), slideshow crossfades take 600ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.25,1), the oversized photographs drift, and script marquees run on CSS time (90-122s per pair). Page changes use a 1s view transition on the same curve; nothing pins, and there is one reduced-motion rule.

references.name: NOTHIN’
references.idea: The studio's name set as a wordmark so large it is the whole hero, repeated in inverted colours as the footer, so 'nothing' is literally the only content on screen.
references.hero: The captured hero frame is a black preloader wipe; this describes the loaded state. White field. A custom heavy geometric wordmark in black spans the full width between 1% margins, vertically centred, about 30% of the viewport tall, its apostrophe hanging at the top-right. Top-left: a two-line statement at about 1.6vw with a small black pill button under it. Top-right: a tiny menu label with a four-dot icon. Along the bottom edge: a one-line studio descriptor at left, two social links and a language chip at right. Everything else is empty white, with no image and no colour.
references.type: PP Neue Montreal medium for statements at up to about 5vw, sentence case, tight tracking and leading; the Book cut for small text; IBM Plex Mono for tiny grey project labels. The wordmark is custom heavy geometric lettering at close to 100vw. Only three text sizes: statement, caption, micro-label.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #2b47e6 #2f5d33 #bfbfbf — Strict black and white that flips by section: white hero and intro, black works and footer. The only colour comes from inside the imagery, chiefly electric-blue foil and fern green.
references.imagery: 3D renders of inflated chrome, crumpled blue foil and bubble-wrap hearts on black; project shots are brand mock-ups photographed in settings (a card among ferns, a laptop on a dark desk). Hard-edged rectangles of varied size, square corners.
references.layout: Margins of about 1%, so content runs nearly edge to edge. The intro is a left headline over a full-width black media panel; the works section places images at irregular widths and horizontal offsets with wide black gaps, each with a mono label and one-line caption above.

sections.description: White section. A two-line statement at about 5vw sits flush left under a small logo mark, filling the top quarter. Below it a black rectangle spans the full content width and runs off the bottom of the viewport, holding a 3D still life clustered at centre. On further scroll the panel shrinks to a small thumbnail docked top-right, while a parenthesised label and a four-line paragraph at caption size appear in two narrow columns at the left.

Black section headed by one bold uppercase word top-left. Project images are placed as a loose scatter: one at about 48% width hugging the left margin, the next narrow and hugging the right margin lower down, the next inset to start 18% across. Above each image sits a tiny grey mono project name, then a one-line white caption at about 1.1vw. A two-line aphorism floats alone at the right between projects. Long stretches of empty black separate items.

Black, full viewport. A two-line invitation at about 5vw at the left in the upper third, with two outlined pill buttons under it; three social links stacked at about 78% across. The wordmark repeats in white at full width, anchored to the bottom, with a single row of micro-text credits beneath it.

steal: Make the hero nothing but the name: a wordmark scaled to the full viewport width on a blank field, with only a two-line statement and one small button in a corner.
Repeat the hero wordmark in inverted colours as the footer so the page opens and closes on the same shape.
Place case-study images at different widths and horizontal offsets on a black field, each with a micro mono label and a single-line caption above it instead of a card.
references.media: No picture on the desktop first screen: a full-width black wordmark on white covers about 30% of the height. Then an inset showreel with 18px gutters scrubs down into a box in the right third as text arrives on the left, a staggered two-column mosaic of 48, 32 and 65% widths, a pinned full-bleed brand film with a blurred copy behind it as a halo, cut-out 3D objects on black with letters tumbling between them, and the wordmark again, inverted, as the footer; 17 images and 4 muted looping videos.
references.motion: The preloader (on the phone capture) morphs a 3D inflatable through three forms while a counter runs down to 000, then white rises in a hard-edged mask to reveal the wordmark. Lenis: the showreel scrubs at 3, works cards drift at their own speeds (y scrub 1.5, yPercent scrub 3), the film pins for one screen, heading letters split and scatter, and services letters and objects tumble in on power2.in at random 0.25-0.69s durations; the house ease is cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) at 0.5-0.6s.

references.name: Lorenzo Bocchi – Shot on iPhone
references.idea: Black-and-white phone photographs fly through dark 3D space as a twisting ribbon, and the viewer chooses how the archive is arranged (reel, wall, trail, drift; flow, grid, map).
references.hero: Pure black canvas filling the viewport. A diagonal helix of portrait photo cards runs from upper-left to lower-right: four cards near the centre are lit and legible (each about 200 by 280px, slightly rounded corners, each rotated a little further around the axis), while cards above and below fade to dark grey blanks curling away. Behind them a single word in ultra-bold condensed caps spans 80% of the width, its letters half the viewport tall, in a grey only a few points lighter than the background. Four pill-shaped control groups sit in the corners: menu label top-left, three view modes top-right, two round icon buttons bottom-left, four layout modes bottom-right.
references.type: GeistSans around 14px inside the pill controls is the only readable text. The giant background word is ultra-bold condensed caps roughly 440px tall, used as texture at near-zero contrast. No headings or captions.
references.colour: #000000 #191919 #262626 #383838 #e6e6e6 — Black and greys only; the photographs are all monochrome, so the brightest values on the page are image highlights. Controls are dark grey capsules with a black active segment.
references.imagery: Black-and-white travel and street photographs, all portrait, with a soft vignette, mapped onto slightly curved cards in WebGL; only cards near the focal plane are lit, the rest fall into darkness.
references.layout: One fixed viewport with no document flow. Content floats in the centre 50% of the screen; interface is pushed to the four corners with 16px insets, leaving edges and middle free for the image stream.

sections.description: Scrolling does not move a page; it advances the ribbon. In each frame three or four cards occupy a diagonal band through the centre, the middle one facing the viewer and neighbours rotated progressively edge-on, like prints on a spiral staircase. Cards leaving focus darken to charcoal silhouettes that continue the curve toward the top-left and bottom-right corners, so the path stays readable even when the images are not.

Navigation is four floating capsules rather than a bar. Each is a dark-grey rounded container; multi-option ones hold a black pill behind the active word, giving three view modes and four layout modes as segmented switches. On mobile the two top capsules sit side by side, the bottom ones merge into one row, and their text scales up to thumb size.

steal: Set a single giant word behind the content at two or three percent contrast so it reads as depth, not as a headline.
Light only the items near the focal point and let the rest fall to dark silhouettes that still trace the path.
Put controls in four corner capsules with a sliding active pill, keeping the whole centre free for content.
